verdict.rationale: Undermind mentions programmatic API access for enterprise and an MCP endpoint, but the evidence never documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The "v1 search engine" mention is marketing about result quality, not API versioning, and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Being an API-offering service, the axis applies, so absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
